title: 建筑制冷负荷：模拟几何描述组合留出基线
question: 固定八原输入线性Ridge对未参与训练的几何描述组合预测制冷负荷时，误差与局部失配如何影响下一步研究？
claim: The fixed numeric-coded additive Ridge baseline has lower pooled held-out geometry-group MAE than its training-fold target-mean reference on the captured simulated records.
alternatives: Orientation and glazing-distribution integers are category codes; treating them as numeric imposes unverified order, distance and linear effects that scaling does not repair.
Exact equality of five published geometry parameters defines operator-derived groups, not certified original building identities or independent real buildings.
Pooled MAE may mask worse groups or local ranges; saved target scale has no unit confirmed by the captured official metadata.
change_reason: Prospective complete768-row Y2-only fixed baseline; no Y1 input, outcome-driven grouping, transformation, tuning or runtime extension.
